lines.en: I head over to Chika’s place first thing in the morning to spend some time with her before she needs to go to work.
lines.zh: 一大早我就去了 Chika 家，想在她上班前陪她待会儿。

lines.en: Seeing as Chinami is already awake once I get there, the three of us spend our morning watching cartoons on her old television that, and this might be a first world complaint, dramatically requires an upgrade.
lines.zh: 我到的时候 Chinami 已经醒了，于是我们仨一上午都围着她那台旧电视看动画片——说这个可能有点身在福中不知福，但那台电视确实该换了。

lines.en: Considering how I’m already paying for both of their phones, though, I doubt I’ll be splurging on any more electronics any time soon.
lines.zh: 不过想想我已经在替她们俩付手机费了，短期内我大概是不会再花钱买什么电器了。

lines.en: Unless she’s willing to let me live here, that is. Which...honestly, she probably would.
lines.zh: 除非她愿意让我住进来。而说实话……她大概真的愿意。

lines.en: But at this point, I don’t think I’ll be able to live anywhere without taking Ami with me.
lines.zh: 但到了这个地步，我想我无论住哪儿都得带上 Ami。

lines.en: And I can’t imagine Ami would be very happy with observing the things I would do to her classmate.
lines.zh: 而且我无法想象 Ami 看到我对她同学做那些事会有多高兴。

lines.en: Eventually, the time comes for me to head out and I walk with Chika to her bus stop, feeling eerily like a man walking his daughter somewhere and not at all like a significant other.
lines.zh: 终于到了要走的时候，我陪 Chika 走到她的公交站，那感觉诡异地像一个父亲送女儿去某处，完全不像个恋人。

lines.en: Well, apart from the unearthly desire to undress her. But, let’s face it, there are plenty of fathers out there thinking that same thing about their daughters every day.
lines.zh: 好吧，除了那种想把她衣服扒光的超自然欲望。不过说真的，天底下每天想着对女儿做同样的事的父亲多了去了。

lines.en: Just not Chika’s on account of the whole...yeah.
lines.zh: 只是 Chika 她爸不会，因为那什么……你懂的。

lines.en: Anyway, Chika heads out and I make my way back into town to figure out what else I want to do today.
lines.zh: 总之，Chika 出门了，我回到镇上，琢磨今天还要干点什么。
Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！
